Founded in 2018 in Córdoba, Argentina. Backed by Y Combinator. Named one of the 100 most promising EdTech startups in Latin America by HolonIQ. +25,000 students per year across Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Brazil.
To become a reference in practical and professional educational solutions, with a strong focus on user experience and team wellbeing.
Founded by Joaquín Olmedo Gastaldi, Nicolás Ferrer, Guillermo Bruchmann Tanodi, and Agustín Trombotto Marsilli — four friends who believed every student deserved world-class exam preparation.

Supported by FIDE, Argentina's Ministry of Productive Development, Incutex, and Universidad Blas Pascal. The team grew, the product evolved, and the first students started getting into their dream universities.
Accepted into Y Combinator (S21) and StartupChile / CORFO. This was the moment Filadd went from a promising startup to a globally-backed EdTech company.
Launched operations in Chile (PAES prep), Colombia (ICFES Saber 11 & U. Nacional), and Brazil (ENEM & Vestibulares). Each country with its own tailored product and local team.
+25,000 students per year across 4 countries, and expanding into India with Padhle by Filadd — a personalized NEET preparation program built to get students into AIIMS.
